dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.doll_talk.si: Big sister... let's take it easy together...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.doll_talk.my: Myamya... Big sister, are you listening to {self}?
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.hatless_jeer: Puff! That bare head is laughable!
Cannot even keep your ornament, how shameful!
Wandering in front of everyone with a bare head!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.hatless_shoo: Do not come closer, go away.
A bare-headed one is in the way.
Keep away, you are spoiling {self}'s ease.
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.hatless_whis: Look... that one has no ornament...
Really no ornament... better keep our distance...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.hatless_answ: Puff! Even without an ornament, {self} is still a yukkuri!
Stop laughing at {self}! The ornament will be found!
Be quiet! Stop looking down on {self}!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.wait_impatie: Honestly, so slow... how long are you going to make {self} wait!
Ugh... dawdling around, keeping {self} from taking it easy!
Mmm... not done yet? {self} is getting tired of waiting...
Still a bit longer...? {self} wants to get going too...
Uu... will it take much longer...? {self} is getting uneasy...
Yuu... when will it be {self}'s turn...?
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.wait_quiet.p: Mmm... not yet, let's wait easy a little longer...
It's okay... just take it easy and wait a moment...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.wait_quiet.t: Yu... {self} will just wait quietly right here...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.wait_quiet.p: Hm... just a tiny bit longer then.
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.yield_pass.p: Hmph, good sense—{self} is coming through first!
Thanks for making room, {self} is coming through!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.lane_blocked: Hey! Don't sleep right in the middle of the lane! {self} can't get past!
What's the idea, snoozing right here and blocking the whole lane!
Yu... fell asleep right here and blocked the whole lane...
Mmm... sleeping right across the path, can't squeeze past...
Y-yu... asleep in the middle of the way... what should {self} do...
Uu... don't want to wake them... but the way is blocked...
Hey! Don't just sit in the middle of the path! {self} can't pass!
Honestly, hogging the whole lane! Move aside a little!
Mmm... the way ahead is packed shut, can't get through...
Yu... the lane is blocked, guess {self} has to back off for now...
Um... can't get through... {self} will step aside first...
Uu... can't squeeze through... better back off a little...
Really! Blocking the lane without budging and wasting {self}'s trip! Hmph, can't take it easy at all!
What's the deal! Hogging the lane so nobody can pass—now {self} is stuck waiting here!
Mmm... the lane is completely blocked, no getting through—guess {self} will give up and stay here...
Nothing to do... the blocker isn't moving, so {self} has to drop this trip for now...
Uu... really can't get around... {self} will just wait quietly over here...
Yuu... blocked from going back... can only wait until they move...
Owner! Taking {self} for a walk? Let's go!
Yay! With Mr. Lead on, {self} will walk with full energy!
Owner, are we going out for an easy walk together?
Yu♪ Mr. Lead is on, {self} will follow nicely!
Yu... taking {self} out, Owner? Please don't walk too fast...
Uu... Mr. Lead is on... {self} will stay right beside you...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.lead_struggl: Hah... hah... w-won't give up... let {self} go...
Ugh... body feels so heavy... why won't this rope snap...
Phew... phew... so tired... please untie the rope...
Uu... can barely pull anymore... really don't want to be taken...
Hah, hah... can't breathe... stop pulling... please spare {self}...
Sniff... out of breath... somebody save {self}...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.lead_strange: Hey! Stupid human! Who let you put Mr. Lead on {self}?! Take it off!
What are you doing?! Don't leash {self}! {self} doesn't want to be a pet!
Yuyu?! A-a rope went around {self}... where are you taking {self}?!
Eek! Mr. Lead is on... Mr. Human, what do you want?!
Yuwaah! S-something tied up {self}... don't take {self} away...!
Sniff... so scary... please, Mr. Human, don't tie {self} up...!
Hmph! Untied at last! Try leashing {self} again and you'll regret it!
Tch, good sense! {self} is leaving, don't follow!
Phew... the rope is finally off... thank goodness nothing happened...
It's off... that gave {self} a fright, still able to take it easy.
I-it's off...! Gotta run, gotta get far away...!
Yuwa! It came off... gotta run right now...!
Phew... not chasing anymore, right...? Being leashed was so scary...
Uu... managed to escape... never want to be caught again...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.hatless_sanc: Bare-headed trash! How dare you wander here—{self} will teach you a lesson!
A fake yukkuri that can't even keep its ornament—no taking it easy here! Get out!
One with no ornament is no yukkuri! You can't stay here, get out!
Get far away from {self}! Don't let {self} see that bare head again!
Get out! A bare-headed one has no business near everyone!
Go away! Don't come near here again!

notebook.mcyukkuri.guide.discovery:
Find and carry

Look in plains, forests and meadows by day.

Craft a transport basket with a chest and two strings. Use on a yukkuri, then on dry ground to release.

Life pauses while carried.
notebook.mcyukkuri.guide.care:
Daily care

Craft a food bowl with a bowl and two clay balls. Fill it with apples or other food.

Cover the nest entrance. Clean litter with a wet cloth. Use the cloth on a water source to refill.
notebook.mcyukkuri.guide.social:
Talk and learn

Right-click with both hands empty: gentle talk.
Sneak-right-click with both hands empty: care menu; speak coldly under Social.
Drop yarn balls for play.

When trusted, start the wait lesson from the pet handbook and stay for three sessions. Afterwards, ask it to wait. Danger interrupts.
notebook.mcyukkuri.guide.rules:
Accessories

Sneak-right-click with both hands empty to open the care menu, then take the accessory under Care. Right-click with shears to cut it. Right-click with a loose accessory to return it; sneak-right-click to hang it under a support.

Peers may not recognize a yukkuri without it; memories remain.

Brief washing differs from prolonged rain and soaking.

Healthy, well-fed adults with nearby homes and mutual familiarity can reproduce. Use a companion cord to introduce them. Young grow after food and rest.
notebook.mcyukkuri.guide.house:
House Yukkuri

Occupied roofed spaces collect lint. Real meals leave crumbs. House Yukkuri settle naturally, by day or night; no crafted home or feeding is required.

notebook.mcyukkuri.guide.settlement:
Wild communities

Membership persists. Food, safety and family care come before duties.

Repeated rejection by harsh witnesses may lead to exclusion or cleaning duties. Returning the original accessory restores recognition and office, but does not reset affection.

human.mcyukkuri.guide.resident: Donate regular feed for care. Accept a missing companion clue, then return that same individual in a transport basket. Trade during daylight.
human.mcyukkuri.guide.factory: Parent groups rotate. Trays carry individuals through receiving, nursery, grading, cleaning and packing with staff present. Choose product use and matching stock. Missing materials/stations, full storage and blocked routes pause work. Deliver reserve adults for vacant parent stations; repair broken trays with four iron. Paper/manju/live bags cost 1/2/4 emeralds.

notebook.mcyukkuri.guide.shelter:
Wild shelters
Yukkuri occupy existing caves or pits and bring loose leaves and bedding. Capacity follows usable ground.
A few twigs form their so-called boundary; they build no walls or roof and gain no defense.
Offer leaves, grass, paper or wheat for bedding, sticks for the boundary, and food for stores.
Cardboard is discarded human property; yukkuri can add lining but cannot repair its shell.
Open pits allow sleep in dry weather; rain forces a search for real cover.
Select a shelter with the notebook, then sneak-click a resident to assign it.

notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.start:
Field notebook

Use in the air for this guide. Use on a yukkuri to read its current state and record its species.

Observing does not feed, heal or change personality.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.route:
First supplies

Book + feather: notebook.
Chest + 2 string: transport basket.
Bowl + 2 clay balls: food bowl.
Hay bale + white wool + string: nest.
3 oak planks + sand: potty.
Build a roof and clear entrance first.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.discovery:
Discovery and transport

Explore plains, forests and meadows. Look for families and shelters.
Use a transport basket on a living yukkuri, then on dry supported ground. Blocked space or water prevents release; the transport basket stays full.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.care:
Food and cleaning

Put apples, bread or oil grain in a bowl. Food provides nutrition only after swallowing.
Wet a cloth at a water source. Use it to clean the potty. Food, waste and cleaning all use real items.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.water:
Water and medicine

Offer water potions or yogurt for dryness, constipation or spicy food. Oral effects begin at swallowing.
Ramune spray has a delay. Stimulant adds drive; baby-talk medicine changes speech, not body age.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.social:
Familiarity

Use an empty hand to talk. Sneak with both hands empty to open the care menu. Use tools directly on the yukkuri. Start lessons from the pet handbook and introduce adults with a cord.
The needs page shows affection, boredom and activities. Danger interrupts care.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.home:
A place to rest

Use the notebook on a nest or shelter to select it, then sneak-use on a yukkuri to assign it. A real entrance and standing space are required.
Twig boundaries do not block rain or enemies.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.family:
Family and growth

Healthy familiar adults need nearby homes, food and rest. Pairing does not guarantee pregnancy; population and sleeping space also matter.
Ancestry records actual parents. Young grow with nourishment and rest.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.birth:
Birth

Standard kinds can bear stems. Apply reproductive filling continuously to an eligible adult for assisted live pregnancy; the father is unknown.
The brood page shows progress. House kinds lay eggs. Detached broods stay in the world.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.house:
House life

Hides in lint by day and peeks out to forage at night. Supply real scraps and lint for carrying, upkeep and egg care.

Sneak empty-handed to lift an egg; use it on a lined nest. Cleaning startles residents. Sneak-cleaning loses eggs still in that nest.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.body:
Body condition

Check health, wounds, and mold. Ordinary filling leaves short-lived traces; remains hold a finite food balance and a separate core. Orange juice and mold medicine have different uses.

Brief washing differs from sustained rain or immersion. Do not lure ordinary species across a river with food; check aquatic forms separately.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.tools:
Tools and interruption

Tools affect real body parts or held items. Follow the operation menu for the target and action.
Distance, danger or movement can interrupt continuous work. Check the item and condition before trying again.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.play:
Play and surroundings

Offer yarn, marbles or dolls. Pipes, slides and trampolines need reachable entrances and landings.
Pools still cause wetness and immersion.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.storage:
Cold storage

Craft with 4 iron ingots, 2 snow blocks, a chest, redstone and an ender pearl.
Use a full transport basket on it. All cabinets share four places per player. Age, physiology and internal pregnancy pause without cold damage.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.retrieval:
Retrieving

Use an empty transport basket to take the oldest occupant, then release on dry ground. Empty-hand use lists the vault.
Breaking a cabinet does not delete occupants. Rebuild to recover them, including after death or travel.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.commerce:
Human facilities

Look for caretakers, shops and factories near settlements. Their menus show current stock and conditions.
Animals retain their identity in trade. Factory work requires real parents, supplies and routes.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.progress:
Survival progress

Get a notebook, observe and assign a home. Also prepare care supplies, store and retrieve an occupant, and raise a real family.
Successful events record once. There are no item or XP rewards to farm.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.status:
Content status

Species pages use the current registry; only actual observation marks discovery.
Predators and new forms have separate acceptance checks. Registration is not full validation. Optional guide/HUD integrations are absent.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.standard_spec:
Standard living kind. Observe the individual for age, personality, family, body and consumable state.
A species name is not a health or intelligence rating.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.house_species:
House ecology. These kinds collect scraps, carry nesting supplies and reproduce through nest eggs.
An ordinary yukkuri does not become a house kind merely by going indoors.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.predator:
Predator kind. Plan separate space from ordinary pets. Flight, hunting, nests and trade are under separate implementation checks.
This registry entry does not certify every behavior.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.no_brood:
Current brood

No active internal or attached-stem brood. Inspect the actual nest or detached stem for external broods.

notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.accessories:
Accessories and badges

notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.community:
Wild families

Forest communities can include several households. Observe membership, leadership and sleeping places.
Wild encounter cards have separate checks. Watching is neither feeding nor adoption; transport is not abandonment.

Biomes and seasons

Plains: spring. Forests: autumn. Snow: winter. Tropics: summer. Days do not change seasons.

Spring sharing, summer shade, autumn stocks and winter shelter follow the local biome.

Food cannot replace warmth.

notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.childhood:
Birth and growth

A parent approaches and lowers its head to pass real mash through mouth contact. The first bowel movement needs nearby parental care. Safe crawling and actual takeoff and landing practice develop movement.

Self-feeding needs 1/4 maturity age and 3/16 nourished growth. A small nest at home needs half maturity age, 3/8 nourished growth and two real plant bedding items.

At 3/4 maturity age and 9/16 nourishment, completed care and movement skills permit subadult independence. Reproduction still needs adulthood.

notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.house_start:
Settling in

People living under a roof leave lint at the foot of walls and furniture (walking, sleeping, shearing, breaking wool and beds) and crumbs (eating, cooking, harvesting crops). These are traces on the floor, not items, and cannot be picked up.

When enough lint and crumbs gather beside a hidden corner nobody is watching, and no house yukkuri lives nearby, one moves in: it carries lint to the corner itself, founds a nest and is later joined by a partner. Time with nobody around does not count; after sweeping, no newcomer arrives for two minutes.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.house_supplie:
Floor debris

One kind per cell, up to 64, fading slowly: lint blows away and crumbs spoil. Inspect with an empty hand.

Players cannot take lint or crumbs; only house yukkuri carry them. Waste swept up with a cloth is the one real item and can be composted.
notebook.mcyukkuri.chapter.house_cleanup:
Housekeeping

Sneak-use a dry cloth to sweep 3×3 debris and deter dust and new settlers for two minutes. Compost the waste.
Use on a dust nest to clean; sneak-use dismantles it and loses its eggs.

dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.cold.seek_wa: Yuu... it's cold here; I want somewhere warmer.
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.rule_tighten: Yes... I remember! If Mr. Owner forbids it, I will hold back.
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.rule_cower: Eeeek...! Please don't be angry, Mr. Owner... I will obey, don't hate me...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.rule_yield: ...Yuu... Mr. Owner is watching... fine, please don't be mad, I will hold back...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.rule_loosen: Yay! Now I can do it! Thank you, Mr. Owner, I love you!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.rule_gratefu: Mr. Owner is the kindest! I will stay good and take it easy with you!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.rule_gasp: Eek...! Mr. Owner...! I got caught...!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.rule_beg: Yuuu... I am sorry, Mr. Owner! Please don't hit me, don't throw me away... forgive me...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.rule_vow: I am truly sorry, Mr. Owner... I will never sneak again...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.rule_excuse: B-but I truly could not hold it in... I did not mean to upset Mr. Owner... sorry...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.rule_wait: Mr. Owner... are you still angry...? Have you come to hate me...?
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.rule_thanks: Yuu...! Mr. Owner forgave me?! Thank you! I will be a good pet!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.rule_accept: Yuu... I was wrong... I learned my lesson, I will obey Mr. Owner from now on...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.rule_withdra: Yuu... Mr. Owner is ignoring me... it's because I was a bad yukkuri... I am sorry...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.lead_hurry: Wait for {self}, Owner! {self} is hopping right after you!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.lead_hurry.p: Yuyu! You're walking so fast, {self} is hurrying to catch up!
Hold on, Owner! {self} will hop right up to you!
Don't leave {self} behind! Watch {self} hop along!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.lead_hurry.t: Uwaah... Owner, wait for {self}... don't leave {self} behind...!
Yuu... t-too fast... {self} is trying so hard to keep up...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.lead_alarm: Yuwa! Mr. Lead is pulled tight! Slow down, Owner!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.lead_alarm.p: Eek! You're pulling too hard! {self} can't keep up!
H-hey! Walk slower, Owner! The lead is pulling too tight!
Yuwa! Don't yank so suddenly! {self} nearly rolled over!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.lead_alarm.t: Yuwaah! It's tight and scary! Please stop, Owner...!
Sniff... Mr. Lead is squeezing... please don't pull so hard...!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.lead_relief: Phew... finally caught up to Owner! Now we can walk easy again!
Whew... made it, that was a close call...
Phew, caught up! {self} is fast too, right, Owner?
Made it! Don't dash ahead like that next time!
Uu... thank goodness... caught up to Owner at last... what a relief...
Phew... I'm so glad {self} didn't get lost...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.lead_struggl: Don't tie {self} up! Let go of Mr. Lead!
Uu... {self} doesn't want to be dragged away... let {self} go back!
Untie it now! {self} can't take it easy like this!
Let {self} go! You can't tie {self} up, stupid human! Let go!
Darn it! This flimsy rope won't hold {self}! Heave—break free!
Hmph! {self} won't go with you! Take this rope off right now!
Yuwaah! Let {self} go... so scary... don't pull {self}...!
Sniff... Mr. Lead is so tight... help... let {self} go...!
No, don't take {self} away... {self} wants to go home... sniff...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.lead_spent: Phew... n-no strength left to fight... pull if you want...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.lead_spent.p: Can't... hold on anymore... so tired...
Hah... hah... c-can't move... darn it... I hate this...
Ugh... no strength left at all... beaten by a stupid rope...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.lead_spent.t: Sniff... zero strength left... so scared... please don't hurt {self}...
Hah... can't move... {self} can't get away anymore...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.confess: I had them in secret… Mr. Owner, please spare the little ones…
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.confess_mate: They were born in secret… Mr. Owner, please spare the little ones…
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.elope_invite: Psst, over here! Out here we can go wherever we like!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.sukkiri_lie: I don't know them! Those aren't my little ones!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.sukkiri_naiv: Look how easy my little ones take it! Now you can take it easy with us, Mr. Owner!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.sukkiri_defi: What's wrong with having cute little ones? I won't say sorry!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.partner_blam: It was that one who asked me to do sukkiri first!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.glass_wait.p: Mr. Glass! Don't block the way! Let the little one through!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.give_up_sear: Little one... I wish we could rub cheeks again... I can't get over there right now...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.glass_child_: Mama, Papa! I'm here! Right here!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.glass_ram.be: Mr. Glass! Be good and move aside!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.braid_rescue: You're on the bank. Catch your breath.
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.self_rescue_: My hat! I'll try to swim over to it!
I got hold of the edge!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.human_food_a: Mr. Human... could I have a little food?
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.human_food_d: Stupid human! Hand over the food!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.mourn_sob.wh: Sob... why... why can't we take it easy together anymore...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.mourn_sob.ca: Sniff... come back... let's take it easy together again...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.mourn_miss.w: ...I wish we could take it easy together again...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.mourn_over.b: Mm... I'll take it easy for both of us!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.vow_partner_: For the little ones, {self} will live an easy life for the both of us, darling!
Sniff... Watch over us, darling... {self} will raise the little ones right...
Leave your share to {self}, darling! Little ones, stick with {self}!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.vow_to_mothe: Mommy... {self} will keep taking it easy, I promise!
Sniff... Mommy... {self} will try hard... Keep watching over {self}, okay?
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.vow_to_fathe: Daddy... {self} will take it easy for the both of us!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.vow_blame_pa: Shitty parent! You went and took it easy forever and left cute little {self} behind!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.vow_for_chil: Little one... {self} will watch over everyone for you too...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.shaken_check: ...Is it gone? Is it really okay now...?
Phew... I can finally take it easy...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.yield_way.me: Uu... I-I'll move out of the way... sorry...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.yield_way.pr: Hmph, I'll let you through... just this once!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.farewell_say: I'm off to find a Mr. Home of my own!
...I'm going to find my own Mr. Home. I'll miss you...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.farewell_ble: Off you go! Take it easy out there!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.farewell_cry: Sniff... come back and see me sometimes...
I'm going! Always take it easy!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.parting_over: That little one will take it easy out there, I'm sure!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.mold_warn.st: Stay back! You'll give it to everyone!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.mold_scorn.g: Moldy ones don't belong here! Get out!
I'm sorry... but the little one would get sick too...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.mold_plea.st: Wait! I can still take it easy! Don't drive me out...!
This is my Mr. Home too! Why are you driving me out?!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.driven_curse: Grr... Fine, I'll go! {self} doesn't care about this place anyway!
You just wait! {self} will make you pay someday!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.child_curse_: Shitty parent! {self} doesn't want a home like this!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.keep_child.s: {self} won't send you away... I'll stay right here with you...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.drive_child_: I'm sorry... I'm sorry... For everyone's sake... please go...!
The hat is full. Work it out yourself.
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.left_ashore_: Wait here... I'll be back, I promise.
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.badge_plaza_: That badge... so sparkly... so pretty...
I practiced hard for this badge!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.mold_sorrow_: I'm sorry... I don't want to part... but it would spread...
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.mold_itch.sk: Sniff... So itchy... What's wrong with {self}'s Mr. Skin...?
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.mold_notice_: Yu? What are those little spots on you...?
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.mold_shun_un: Yuck! Keep those spots away from me!
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.beg_ask.bite: I'm so hungry... could I have a bite?
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.beg_offer.sh: Here, you can have a bite.
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.beg_thanks.f: Thank you! Finally, something to eat.
dialogue.mcyukkuri.original.beg_help.hid: Help! It keeps staring at my food!

pet.mcyukkuri.lesson.refuse.need_poise: The Poise lesson needs another yukkuri within 8 blocks.
pet.mcyukkuri.card.promise: Wait quietly and you get a snack

pet.mcyukkuri.ui.tip.need_1: Cannot start just now. Try again shortly.
pet.mcyukkuri.ui.tip.need_2: Needs a sweet (candy, cookie or pudding) in your inventory.
pet.mcyukkuri.ui.tip.ok.0: Practices eating, relieving or sleeping at a facility, about 15 s. The screen closes on start.
pet.mcyukkuri.ui.tip.ok.1: A question card appears; it thinks and answers, about 15 s. The screen closes on start.
pet.mcyukkuri.ui.tip.ok.2: A promise game: wait patiently; success uses up a sweet, about 15 s. While the "?" shows after any lesson, one more sweet is a reward (one per lesson). The screen closes on start.
pet.mcyukkuri.ui.tip.ok.3: Walks over to greet another yukkuri, about 15 s. The screen closes on start.
